UNDER the series of the orders regarding the preparation and plans and the publication of the list of names of the roads and narrow lanes maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2316/20 and dated 24th January in 2023 by the Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province and orders of the Section 24 (1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 , it is hereby notice to the public that all the roads and narrow lanes, which have not been assigned a case in a competent court before the date speciﬁ ed in the said notice and the roads and narrow lanes that had been assigned a case in competent court and conﬁ rmed in accordance with the decisions given by the court that they are possessed to the Pradeshiya Sabha, among the roads and narrow roads in the schedule containing the notice published in the Gazette No. 2398/05 and dated 20th August 2024, considered to be in the possession of the Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha, shall be conﬁ rmed to possess to Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha under No. 14 on 04th of December, 2024.

List of names of said roads and narrow lanes are included in the schedule here and it is hereby further announced that all roads and narrow lane included in it shall be possessed to Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub Section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act.
K. A. T. M. Kඎൽൺ Aඋൺർඁർඁං, Secretary and Enforcement Oﬃ cer, Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha.
